title: 12 Heads from the Garden of Perfect Brightness

sentences.en: February 23rd, 2009, Christie's International in Paris held a much-anticipated three-day auction
sentences.zh: 2009年2月23日，巴黎佳士得国际拍卖行举行了一场备受瞩目的三天拍卖会，

sentences.en: from the private art collection of the late fashion designer Yves Saint-Laurent.
sentences.zh: 拍品来自已故时装设计师伊夫·圣罗兰的私人艺术收藏。

sentences.en: The auction took place at the historic Grand Palais,
sentences.zh: 拍卖会在历史悠久的大皇宫举行，

sentences.en: and the items up for sale were 733 pieces that Saint-Laurent and his partner,
sentences.zh: 待售物品共有733件，是圣罗兰和他的伴侣

sentences.en: Pierre Berger, had amassed over five decades.
sentences.zh: 皮埃尔·贝尔热历经五十年积累而成的。

sentences.en: The French press dubbed this the sale of the century.
sentences.zh: 法国媒体将此称为“世纪拍卖”。

sentences.en: There was a piece by Marcel Duchamp, a painting from Picasso's Cubist period,
sentences.zh: 其中有马塞尔·杜尚的作品，一幅毕加索立体主义时期的画作，

sentences.en: even a landscape by Edgar Degas that had once hung at Pierre Berger's bedside.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一幅埃德加·德加的风景画，它曾挂在皮埃尔·贝尔热的床头。

sentences.en: Interested buyers from all over the world flocked to the Champs-Élysées for a piece of the action.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的买家蜂拥至香榭丽舍大街，想要分一杯羹。

sentences.en: It will be a great, great event, you know, an event the like of which we've never seen before,
sentences.zh: 这将是一场非常、非常盛大的活动，你知道，这种规模的活动我们从未见过，

sentences.zh: 无论是从聚集来看圣罗兰收藏的人数上来说，

sentences.en: but also in terms of the prices that will be achieved.
sentences.zh: 还是从最终达成的价格上来说。

sentences.en: But probably the two most anticipated items at the event were a pair of bronze animal heads from China.
sentences.zh: 但此次活动中最受期待的两件拍品，可能是一对来自中国的青铜兽首。

sentences.en: One of a rabbit and one of a rat that dated back to the 18th century Qing dynasty.
